cards.title: The dot swells into Approve
cards.origin: the status dot beside the 'Approve' label
cards.frame_a: a small grey dot at the row's left edge
cards.move: 0-0.6 s the dot fills orange; 0.6-1.4 s it grows until it is the Approve button's rounded face; 1.4-2.2 s the label types itself onto the face
cards.bridge: at 1.4 s the orange circle is both the status dot and the button's left cap
cards.handoff: the orange colour, the left position and the rounded silhouette
cards.says: approval is the dot finishing its job
cards.setup: none needed: the dot is on screen from the first frame
cards.precedent: a status dot filling, but here the dot becomes the button

build.simplest: a CSS circle scaled by GSAP

cards.title: Cursor drags the row to Paid
cards.frame_a: the cursor over the Approve button
cards.move: 0-0.5 s the cursor clicks; 0.5-1.6 s it drags the approved row right while the row's green fill follows it; 1.6-2.4 s the row lands in the Paid column and stops
cards.frame_b: the row sitting in the Paid column
cards.bridge: at 1.6 s the cursor tip is both on the button's edge and on the Paid column's edge
cards.handoff: the cursor position and its right-moving vector
cards.setup: none needed: the dot is on screen from the first frame
cards.precedent: a status dot filling, but here the dot becomes the button

cards.bridge: at 0.8 s the N is a toolbar letter and a headline bar at once
cards.says: the form becomes the problem it creates
